crossRefs.note: but I tell you, don’t swear at all: neither by heaven, for it is the throne of God;
Yahweh is in his holy temple. Yahweh is on his throne in heaven. His eyes observe. His eyes examine the children of men.
Yahweh says, “Heaven is my throne, and the earth is my footstool. What kind of house will you build to me? Where will I…
‘heaven is my throne, and the earth a footstool for my feet. What kind of house will you build me?’ says the Lord. ‘Or…
Immediately I was in the Spirit. Behold, there was a throne set in heaven, and one sitting on the throne
that looked like a jasper stone and a sardius. There was a rainbow around the throne, like an emerald to look at.

translations.web: He who swears by heaven, swears by the throne of God, and by him who sits on it.
translations.bsb: And he who swears by heaven swears by God’s throne and by the One who sits on it.
translations.kjv: And he that shall swear by heaven, sweareth by the throne of God, and by him that sitteth thereon.
translations.asv: And he that sweareth by the heaven, sweareth by the throne of God, and by him that sitteth thereon.
